thread:
marta: quick heads up — small ABI tweak merged into runtime-matmul at 23:08 UTC. It's a non-functional shim but changes the symbol table; want to run a lightsweep during the 02:00-03:30 UTC change window tonight.

marta: proposed plan: staged images, staggered drain across regions, 5m rollout step, health checks + short perf smoke. fallback image is runtime-matmul:legacy-shim-20260319.

devon: @marta can you paste the exact image tag and the deploy command we'll use?

marta: image: runtime-matmul:shim-abifix-20260320
marta: deploy command (ops-run):
```
/deploy runtime-matmul:shim-abifix-20260320 --regions eu-west-1,us-central1,ap-southeast-1 --stagger 5m --health-checks /smoke/fast --bake 10m --fallback runtime-matmul:legacy-shim-20260319
```

kai: I can own eu-west-1 bake and immediate rollback if perf P50 increases >20% OR error rate >0.5% for 5m.

anika: I'll monitor embedding paths and kv-cache hit ratios. If kv cache miss spikes we abort and pin to legacy.

deploybot: Deploy queued: runtime-matmul:shim-abifix-20260320. Estimated start 02:05 UTC. Stagger 5m. Notifying on #eng-runtime-status.

marta: quick preflight checklist (copying here):
- build artifact validated (sha256: a3f9...c1d2)
- unit and integration tests green on staging
- compatibility test: shim symbol table load OK on python/torch runtimes
- rollback image pushed and signed
- release notes drafted, see PR #1245

devon: added ops sighoff. I'll be on-call 01:50-04:00 UTC. If anything flaps I'll trigger rollback and post the reason here.

kai: one more: please set the ROI gating to require both p50 latency AND error checks to trip before full rollback. We don't want noisy single-metric flips to roll everything.

marta: good call. gating: (p50 > +20% for 3 consecutive mins) AND (5m error rate >0.5%) OR (request failures >1% for 3m). If gating trips, deploybot will run rollback command.

ops-bot: noted. Creating ephemeral incident channel #incident-matmul-237412 for postmortem if needed.

anika: I'll run a focused prompt set to check generation regressions after each region bake (script: tools/regressions/run_small.sh). If anything looks off I'll echo examples here.

devon: one ask — keep CPU batch size flags pinned to current defaults in this rollout. No perf tuning during the window.

marta: ack. no tuning during rollout.

deploybot: rollout started: eu-west-1 -> 5% traffic -> 02:05 UTC. Monitoring streams: perf, errors, kv, cache-hit, mem.

kai: eu-west initial 5% looks clean at +1m. p50 stable.

anika: regression harness shows no semantic diff for our smoke prompts.

devon: moving to 20% now.

deploybot: eu-west at 20% -> 02:20 UTC.

marta: if eu-west holds for 15m we'll proceed to us-central1. Otherwise we pause and triage.

(devon) 02:40 UTC: eu-west held 30m. Proceeding to us-central1.

deploybot: us-central1 started 02:45 UTC -> 5%.

kai: us-central1 had a small pod OOM at step 2, restarted once. p50 spike +12% for 2m, error rate stayed <0.2%. I'm holding at 5% to observe.

anika: regression harness on us-central shows one tokenization edge-case — sharing snippet in channel. Not a blocker but monitor.

devon: I trimmed the rollout to 10% until we understand the OOM cause. tagging infra.

marta: decision: keep us-central at 10%, escalate to infra on OOM. If OOM repeats we'll rollback us-central only and continue ap-southeast.

ops-bot: infra pinged. Incident channel created.

deploybot: ap-southeast-1 bake scheduled 03:10 UTC.

marta: final note for postmortem: capture image signature, kernel-abi diff, kv-cache stats, and why OOM happened in us-central. Add to release notes.

devon: all good from my side. Will post explicit rollback message here if triggered.

marta: thanks everyone. I'll open the release note PR and tag eng-runtime for triage tomorrow. :thumbsup:
